definitions.gloss: the self; one's own person; oneself (as an abstract concept)
definitions.explanation: A formal, written word for "the self" as an abstract concept, or as the first element of compound nouns such as {自己|じこ}{紹介|しょうかい} (self-introduction) and {自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか} (self-evaluation). Rarely used alone in ordinary conversation — speakers prefer {自分|じぶん} when referring to themselves concretely.

examples.japanese: {自己|じこ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{自己|じこ}⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参加|さんか}して→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please participate at your own risk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自己|じこ}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{理解|りかい}している→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: He is good at self-analysis and understands his strengths and weaknesses well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{自己|じこ}PR⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: In job interviews, there is always time set aside for self-promotion.

notes:
A formal, Sino-Japanese word for "the self." In modern Japanese, {自己|じこ} is rarely used as a standalone pronoun — speakers say ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ in conversation. Its main role is as the first element of a large family of compound nouns from psychology, business, law, and self-help writing.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (extremely productive):
- {自己|じこ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧: self-introduction
- {自己|じこ}⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: personal responsibility; at one's own risk
- {自己|じこ}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: self-evaluation
- {自己|じこ}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: self-analysis
- {自己|じこ}⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧: self-assertion
- {自己|じこ}⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧: self-satisfaction; complacency (often negative)
- {自己|じこ}⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧: self-centered
- {自己|じこ}⟦{嫌悪|けんお}→嫌悪：05998_keno⟧: self-loathing
- {自己|じこ}⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧: self-actualization; self-realization
- {自己|じこ}{流|りゅう}: one's own style; self-taught way
- {自己|じこ}PR: self-promotion (job interviews)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: oneself; myself — the ordinary, conversational word; used as a pronoun and in everyday speech.
- {自己|じこ}: the self — written/abstract; used almost exclusively in compounds and formal writing.
- ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧: the person themselves; in person — used to distinguish a person from a proxy or representative.
- ⟦{我|われ}→我：30648_ware⟧: I; self — literary and philosophical.

USAGE WARNING:
Do not use {自己|じこ} in place of ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ in normal sentences. Saying {自己|じこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧です is unnatural — say ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧です (or simply ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧です).

{自己|じこ} is best thought of as a stem for building abstract compounds rather than a pronoun.
